artworks.title: Monsieur Coquelet... partage son... déjeuner
artworks.medium: crayon lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift in memory of Dr. Ruth B. Benedict by the Washington Print Club and Her Friends
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a seated elderly man, who is wearing a nightcap and a simple robe-like garment. He is leaning over a table with a placid expression on his elongated face, characterized by a prominent nose and sunken cheeks. His hair is covered by the nightcap. The man is feeding a small dog that is standing on the table, which is covered with a cloth. Nearby, another small creature with a cat-like appearance is perched on his shoulders facing outwards. The room has patterned wallpaper with a picture hanging on the wall to the left and a dark draped curtain or hanging coat on the far right. The setting is a modest, confined space with little decoration or furniture visible aside from a simple wooden chair and a faintly visible dish on the floor.

artworks.title: 8 heures du matin
artworks.medium: crayon lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift in memory of Dr. Ruth B. Benedict by the Washington Print Club and Her Friends
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing at a window, with exaggerated facial features. He is wearing a nightshirt and pajama trousers, with slippers on his feet. He is holding a cup and a newspaper, while a small dog stands nearby. A cat is curled up on a tabletop next to a candlestick, and there is a bird in a cage and potted plants nearby. The background includes a chair and a partly open cabinet.

artworks.title: 9 heures du soir
artworks.medium: crayon lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift in memory of Dr. Ruth B. Benedict by the Washington Print Club and Her Friends
artworks.description: The image depicts an elderly individual reclining in a bed. The person is lying back against pillows, with their head turned slightly to the side. They have an angular face with pronounced cheekbones and are wearing a nightcap. The individual's eyes are closed. They are dressed in a nightgown, partly covered by a blanket with a floral pattern. The person extends one arm out to hold a candlestick on a small table beside the bed. Around the bed, there are patterned curtains, and the bed is covered with a quilt. A pair of slippers lies on the floor near the foot of the bed. The background consists of shadowy areas.

artworks.title: Sept heures
artworks.medium: crayon lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift in memory of Dr. Ruth B. Benedict by the Washington Print Club and Her Friends
artworks.description: The image shows two men walking hand in hand on a cobblestone street. Both men wear long coats, trousers, and top hats. The man on the right has a lanky build, prominent cheekbones, and a sharp chin. He holds a cane. The man on the left is slightly plumper with a rounded face. A small dog walks beside them. In the background are sketched buildings and a woman in a bonnet and long gown walking away, with another dog in the distance.

artworks.title: 5 heures du soir
artworks.medium: crayon lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift in memory of Dr. Ruth B. Benedict by the Washington Print Club and Her Friends
artworks.description: This is an illustration of a chaotic room with a small dog causing turmoil. The dog is on a disrupted table with scattered objects like cards and broken crockery on the floor. A top hat is on a hook nearby. Two individuals are depicted, one gesturing animatedly while leaning over the table, and another figure stands in the background. The scene captures the energetic and comedic disarray of a spontaneous domestic disturbance.

artworks.title: Trois heures
artworks.medium: crayon lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift in memory of Dr. Ruth B. Benedict by the Washington Print Club and Her Friends
artworks.description: The image shows a group of men lined up at a counter. The men are presented as caricatures, with exaggerated facial features and various styles of 19th-century attire. Some men are visible from the waist up, while others are shown in full standing positions. Each man is engaged with their surroundings, either facing the desk or interacting with others nearby. The background includes additional people and furnishings found in a bureaucratic setting.

artworks.title: 7 heures du matin
artworks.medium: crayon lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift in memory of Dr. Ruth B. Benedict by the Washington Print Club and Her Friends
artworks.description: The image depicts a man lying in bed, from the head to the knees. He is in a reclining position with a pillow under his head and covered by a blanket. The man has prominent cheekbones and a narrow chin. He is wearing a nightcap and a nightgown, with his eyes closed and a subtle smile. A cat is on his legs and a small dog is near the bed, interacting with him. A side table next to the bed holds a tall candlestick. Draped curtains form the background, and clothing items are scattered under the bed with slippers on the floor.

artworks.title: 10 heures du matin
artworks.medium: crayon lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift in memory of Dr. Ruth B. Benedict by the Washington Print Club and Her Friends
artworks.description: The image depicts an elderly man holding a pair of gloves, standing in front of a mirror. He has a monocle and sparse hair combed back under a top hat. His outfit includes a dark coat, light waistcoat, and fitted trousers. A small dog stands beside him. Behind him is a chair draped with a coat or cape, and a curtain hangs in the background. The mirror reflects his image and shows an umbrella leaning against a wall cabinet. The setting suggests a domestic room with wood-paneled walls and ornate details.

artworks.title: 11 heures du matin
artworks.medium: crayon lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift in memory of Dr. Ruth B. Benedict by the Washington Print Club and Her Friends
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an older man walking with a dog in a windy landscape. The drawing depicts an older man with exaggerated, caricature-like features, wearing a tall hat and clutching an umbrella and his coat against a gusty wind. The landscape around him is gently sketched, with hills and a path on which he walks alongside a small dog. The title at the top reads "LA JOURNÉE DU CÉLIBATAIRE" (The Day of the Bachelor), and below states "11 HEURES DU MATIN" (11 in the morning). The drawing is done in a style typical of satirical illustrations from 19th-century France.

artworks.title: Une heure
artworks.medium: crayon lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift in memory of Dr. Ruth B. Benedict by the Washington Print Club and Her Friends
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a park scene. A man is depicted in motion with a small dog interacting with him. Beside them, another person is in water appearing distressed. In the background, there are several figures in the park. The drawing style is caricature with exaggerated features and expressions.

artworks.title: 2 heures
artworks.medium: crayon lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift in memory of Dr. Ruth B. Benedict by the Washington Print Club and Her Friends
artworks.description: The image depicts two men standing. The man on the right has wide eyes, a long face, and disheveled hair under a top hat. He wears a long coat, a vest, and trousers, holding an apple. The man on the left, bent slightly, wears similar clothing and leans on a cane. A small dog is next to the man on the right. In the background, there are sketchy architectural elements and what looks like a poster and produce. The style resembles a pencil or charcoal drawing.

artworks.title: Sans doute M. Riflot le droit...
artworks.medium: crayon lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift in memory of Dr. Ruth B. Benedict by the Washington Print Club and Her Friends
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three cartoonish, older gentlemen dressed in formal 19th-century attire, conversing in a light-hearted manner. The drawing is executed in black and white with use of shading to define the characters' exaggerated features and expressions. The central gentleman appears to be animated in conversation with the one on the right, who holds a newspaper under his arm, while the third figure stands observing. In the foreground, a dog sniffs the ground. The text at the top reads "La Journée du Célibataire" indicating "The Day of the Bachelor."

artworks.title: The Philosophers' Meal
artworks.medium: etching in black on green laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
image (sheet trimmed within parts of plate mark): 20.5 x 31.1 cm (8 1/16 x 12 1/4 in.)
sheet: 25.8 x 33.9 cm (10 3/16 x 13 3/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Katharine Shepard Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a group of eight men around a table. Four men are seated while others stand. The seated men are engaged in conversation, one man is raising his hand. They have different facial features and hairstyles, with one man wearing a hat. The men wear long coats, waistcoats, and cravats. There is a server in the background carrying a dish. The room's background is plain. No jewelry is visible on the individuals.

artworks.title: The Pont du Carrousel, Paris: View to the West from the Pont des Arts
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: From just over a paved walkway running alongside a river, we look across the placid water toward a bridge spanning two banks of an elegant city in this horizontal, sepia-toned photograph. Printed in warm, rich tones of brown and ivory, the horizon line comes almost halfway up the composition. A few low, blocky barges and boats line the smooth river in front of us and along the opposite bank. The span of the bridge ahead of us is supported by three shallow arches with circles in descending sizes where the arches meet the pillars and the flat top of the bridge deck. A long building with rows of windows leading to a high peaked roof runs parallel to the river to our right. More buildings face the river to our left in the distance. A few shadowy forms near the left edge of the photograph, close to us, were created as people moved during the long exposure time needed for the image.

artworks.title: Magasin, Avenue des Gobelins
artworks.medium: gelatin silver print
artworks.dimensions:
sheet: 22.5 x 17.8 cm (8 7/8 x 7 in.)
overall: 45.7 x 35.6 cm (18 x 14 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a sepia-toned photograph of a shop window display featuring mannequins dressed in coats and long dresses. There are four mannequins positioned inside the window, their bodies turned slightly to the right, their hands and arms in different positions. They all have pale skin, thin, arched eyebrows, and hair styled in tight curls around their face. Displayed in front of them are several umbrellas with price tags. Behind the mannequins appears to be a paneled wall with some curtains hanging down. The window glass reflects the landscape in front of the store, which includes a building, trees, and a pale sky.

artworks.title: Honoré Daumier
artworks.medium: salted paper print
artworks.creditLine: Patrons' Permanent Fund

artworks.title: Catherine prépare le tub et Louise nue se coiffe (Catherine Prepares the Bath and Louise, Nude, Fixes her Hair)
artworks.medium: softground etching and etching with monoprint inking in brown and black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing with her arms raised, potentially adjusting her hair. She has closed eyes and dark hair that she appears to be holding. The woman is nude, with a second figure seated to the right. The setting is depicted in earthy tones with textured lines, resembling a sketch or etching. The background consists of light and dark shades, with abstract forms hinting at a simplistic interior setting.

artworks.title: Young Woman in Black
artworks.medium: oil on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait of a woman seated in a three-quarter pose facing forward. Her head is slightly turned to the left, and her arms are crossed in front of her. She has fair skin, soft facial features, and blue eyes. Her dark brown hair is styled in a smooth fashion, parted in the middle and pinned back. She is wearing a black dress with a high collar, accented by a yellow bow tied at her neckline. The background is a blend of gray and beige with sketch-like brushstrokes.

artworks.title: Seated Lady in Black, Trouville
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite on laid paper; laid down
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman seated on a chair, seen from her back side. She is turned slightly to the left, with her head also turned to the side. Her hair is styled neatly and covered with a headscarf. She is wearing a voluminous black dress, and the chair she is sitting on has a simple design. The background is plain and there are no visible accessories or objects. The drawing is dated "1868" in the upper right corner.

artworks.title: Geraniums
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: This painting shows three large potted plants with round green leaves that fill most of the page. The pots are clustered together, their leaves overlapping. The leaves are painted in various shades of green, and the gray-brown pots cast dark gray and blue shadows on the background, which is beige paper.

artworks.title: Roses in a Bottle [recto]
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: A bouquet of at least six red and pink-edged white flowers in a blue bottle is at the center of this vertical, still-life watercolor. Some petals are picked out with blue-gray lines, and the blooms are touched with areas of golden yellow, emerald green, and sky blue around a graphite sketch. The bottom portion of the bottle itself fades away with sketchy lines and washes about three-quarters of the way down the painting. The space behind the flowers is painted with loose strokes making widely spaced, overlapping, diagonal bands filled in with frosty green, mauve pink, smoky pale purple, and muted blue. Another set of bands angling into the composition from the left edge could represent the corner of a table.

artworks.title: Waking Up [verso]
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image depicts an incomplete sketch featuring a nude figure lying down with their body stretched horizontally in the bottom left corner. The figure's facial features are not detailed, and the hair is short and indistinct. Above the reclining figure, another person is sitting with their upper body visible, interacting with a bowl or similar object. The second person has dark hair and undefined facial features. A large vase with plant-like elements and a cat curling up near the reclining figure are also present. The background consists of abstract shapes and colors, with muted greens, blues, and earthy tones against plain paper.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait [recto]
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a man's head and upper body in a three-quarter view. The man is bald with hair on the sides. He has pronounced facial features, including eyebrows and a nose, along with a beard or mustache. The sketch includes shadows and contours for depth. He appears to be wearing a jacket or coat, and the background is plain.

artworks.title: Study of a Rock [verso]
artworks.medium: watercolor on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows wispy, diagonal lines spreading from a cluster of soft, muted colors at the bottom right corner. The background is mostly empty with a faint horizontal division separating the top and bottom sections.
